recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11365 unless the responsible work group makes a new decision to constrain SNOMED display/designation selection in generated expansions.
issue_request: FHIR-11365 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 clarification for MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationPrescription, and MedicationStatement route-code artifacts. It reported that the route-codes expansion displayed some SNOMED CT concepts with the "(qualifier value)" semantic tag and others without it, and asked why the build process chose inconsistent displays.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 11563. The migrated git history contains b6754c234cfadd320aea6259f0e6732f8b49c5d4, the matching build@11563 commit titled "update snomed ct content in cache", which refreshed source/snomed/snomed.xml and many vscache entries rather than changing the route ValueSet definition itself. That embedded SNOMED cache source is no longer present in the current build-source tree.
additional_context: The current medication resources are active in source/fhir.ini, and MedicationPrescription is now represented by MedicationRequest. The current route binding resolves to the shared http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/route-codes definition in source/datatypes/valueset-route-codes.xml. Later issue FHIR-42606 changed that value set from is-a to descendent-of 284009009, confirming that membership is maintained in the datatypes ValueSet source while leaving display selection to terminology expansion. The current build page expands the value set from tx.fhir.org based on SNOMED CT International 01-Feb-2025.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current FHIR source has no hard-coded route-code display rows to normalize; Coding.display is defined as a representation following the code system's rules; and the current expansion's display/designation columns are generated from terminology service data.

related_jiras.note: A later Applied pharmacy correction changed route-codes from is-a to descendent-of 284009009, confirming the current authoritative route ValueSet source and removing the generic parent concept.
